name: 300 Montgomery Street
note: Classical Beaux-Arts tower with tan granite and punched windows. Photos 01-03 show the full building clearly from street level with prominent cornice.

name: 550 California Street
note: Modernist tower with vertical fins and arched base. Photos 01-02 clearly show the facade character and architectural rhythm.

name: Unnamed tower
note: Modern dark glass curtain wall with vertical fins. Photos 01-03 show the sleek facade and contemporary design clearly.

name: Institute of Contemporary Art San Francisco
note: Modern minimalist building with dark base and recessed glazing above. Photos 01-02 show the distinctive arched openings and horizontal banding.

name: Alvinza Hayward Building
note: Classical Beaux-Arts building with tan granite, regular punched grid, and ornamental cornice. Photos 01-02 clearly show the architectural character.

name: Exchange Block Building
note: 1980s postmodern granite building with polished stone facade and regular punched windows. Photos 01-02 show the clean geometric facade.

name: Leidesdorff Place
note: Classical granite building with distinctive arched window openings on lower level. Photos 01-02 show the elegant arched arcade base.

name: San Francisco Pacific Exchange Building
note: Classical 1930 banking hall with grey granite, rusticated base, and heavy ornamental cornice. Photos 01-02 show the masterful neoclassical composition.

name: Unnamed sliver building
note: Narrow wedge-shaped building with mixed red and tan brick and arched window openings. Photos 01-02 show the distinctive mixed-brick facade.

name: San Francisco Curb Exchange Building
note: Classical banking building with golden-tan stone, arched lower arcade, and ornamental cornice. Photos 01-02 show the distinctive neoclassical character.
